summary: abilities-effects owns modifier collection/aggregation (ModifierEngine, single aggregator with signature-keyed caches), acquisition evaluation (AbilityEngine), the PASSIVE/ACTIVE/RULE execution model, rule enums and managed effect intents. Two live bypasses: managed-effect expiry writes owned ActiveEffects directly, and lineage credit awards write credits and chat outside TransactionEngine/SWSEChat. A dead legacy rule framework still carries a D&D crit-confirm rule contrary to A-18.

responsibilities.responsibility: Collect all modifiers for an actor
Aggregate/resolve modifier totals with stacking rules
Signature-keyed modifier caches with explicit invalidation (A-16)
Passive ability registration before derived calc
Managed effect intents to modifier data; turn/combat-end expiry
Rule enum and rule parameter definitions
Progression-event ability effects (lineage credit awards etc.)

publicInterfaces.contract: async; cached by source signature; returns clones

subsystemContracts.interface: sources produce createModifier() objects; ModifierEngine owns stacking/totals; weapon source pulled via WeaponsEngine.getWeaponModifiers

contradictions.observed: Imports WeaponsEngine, EncumbranceEngine, droid/vehicle gates and dialogs/effect-intent-engine (global CR-05)
RULES.CRITICAL_CONFIRM_BONUS is a live rule type with definition; unreachable rule module and unused roll-config rollCriticalConfirmation implement it

foundryAcceptance.item: Managed-effect expiry at turn start/combat end (GM client)
Lineage credit award flow after rerouting to TransactionEngine

findings.title: Managed-effect expiry writes owned ActiveEffects directly
findings.observed: disableExpiredEffectsOnDocument calls document.updateEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", ...) on the actor and on each owned item, from combat turn-start/combat-end hooks (GM only). This bypasses ActorEngine.updateActiveEffects (actor-engine.js:4203) and its normalization/recalc; no @mutation-exception comment.
findings.intendedOwnership: Owned AE changes go through ActorEngine (A-02).
findings.proposedSolution: Route actor effects through ActorEngine.updateActiveEffects(actor, updates) and owned-item effects through an ActorEngine owned-item effect helper (add one if missing) with source "swse-basic-effect-*".
findings.alternatives: Document as exception (not recommended: owned docs).
findings.regressionTests: Unit test with fake ActorEngine: expiry calls updateActiveEffects, never document.updateEmbeddedDocuments.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Turn-start expiry in a live combat with GM and player clients.
findings.risk: Low; active effects are a runtime-risk area.

findings.title: Lineage credit awards bypass TransactionEngine and SWSEChat
findings.observed: _applyCreditsUpdate reads system.credits and writes credits+N through ActorEngine.updateActor; _notifyCreditsGranted posts ChatMessage.create directly. TransactionEngine.executeCreditAdjustment exists (scripts/engine/store/transaction-engine.js:557). Live via progression-engine.js and finalize-integration.js.
findings.intendedOwnership: Credit movement through TransactionEngine (A-10); gameplay chat through SWSEChat (A-05).
findings.proposedSolution: Replace _applyCreditsUpdate with TransactionEngine.executeCreditAdjustment (grant, source = ability) and _notifyCreditsGranted with SWSEChat (or the store receipt hook swseCreditGrantComplete which already renders a card, scripts/chat/store-receipt-chat.js:414). Amount and trigger unchanged.
findings.regressionTests: Test: lineage grant creates one TransactionEngine adjustment and no direct updateActor credit write.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Level-up with Lineage talent in Foundry.
findings.risk: Medium: credits and progression finalization are runtime-risk areas.

findings.title: EffectIntentEngine is an engine filed under scripts/dialogs/ (A-07 hits are a filing error)
findings.observed: A 1,691-line engine (intent schema, modifier conversion, lifecycle expiry, persistence) with 11 importers, imported by ModifierEngine and active-effect-adapter, lives in the dialog folder next to its editor UI.
findings.intendedOwnership: Engine code in scripts/engine/effects/; dialog keeps only presentation.
findings.proposedSolution: Move EffectIntentEngine (and its pure helpers) to scripts/engine/effects/effect-intent-engine.js; leave the dialog importing it. Split lifecycle/expiry (writer) from intent<->modifier conversion (pure).
findings.simplificationBenefit: Two A-07 edges removed; clearer ownership.

findings.title: Dead legacy rule framework including a D&D critical-confirmation rule
findings.observed: scripts/engine/rules/** (rules-registry + 12 rule modules) has no runtime importer (registry: unreachable-importers-only/orphan). The CRITICAL_CONFIRM_BONUS rule type remains live in rule-enum/rule-definitions and is consumed by combat-utils.getCriticalConfirmBonus, used only by roll-config.rollCriticalConfirmation which has no caller. A-18 excludes D&D crit confirmation.
findings.intendedOwnership: No dead rule framework; no D&D crit-confirm mechanics (A-18).
findings.proposedSolution: Delete scripts/engine/rules/** (legacy C). Delete rollCriticalConfirmation/getCriticalConfirmBonus (ROL F-ROL-002). Retiring the CRITICAL_CONFIRM_BONUS rule type requires confirming no item data uses it (packs grep found none).
findings.regressionTests: Full CI; pack scan for CRITICAL_CONFIRM_BONUS.
findings.simplificationBenefit: -~470 SLOC; removes a rule contradicting A-18.

findings.title: DerivedOverrideEngine computes HALF_LEVEL and ability mod independently of actor-core helpers
findings.observed: _getHalfLevel uses floor(system.level/2); level-split provides getHeroicHalfLevel/getEffectiveHalfLevel. _getAbilityMod recomputes from attributes as fallback. HALF_LEVEL is referenced only by orphan phase-3-feat-definitions.js and the contract, so no live feature uses it.
findings.intendedOwnership: Level and ability-mod arithmetic from one owner (actor-core level-split, derived attributes).
findings.proposedSolution: Delegate _getAbilityMod to derived attributes only and leave HALF_LEVEL unimplemented (throw/deny) until a feature needs it; which level (heroic vs character) a generic HALF_LEVEL means is a rules question to raise at that time.

findings.title: Unreachable abilities-effects modules
findings.observed: Static orphans or importers-only. Name mentions: ModifierEngineExtensions only in a ModifierEngine comment; AbilityExecutionRouter mentioned by force-power-adapter/ActivationLimitEngine (comments, no import); ModifierInspector referenced by orphan v2-comprehensive-audit and a template; effect-sanitizer self-registers hooks but nothing imports it; destiny-effects imported by unreachable destiny-hooks/destiny-spending-dialog.
findings.proposedSolution: Delete orphans with static proof (legacy C). Investigate effect-sanitizer (preCreate/preUpdate hooks were intended sanitation) and destiny-effects (Destiny effects UI) as UNIMPLEMENTED integrations before deleting; owner decides.

findings.title: Probe false positives and non-duplicate leads
findings.observed: duration-engine A-02 hits are Map.delete on a private in-memory map (false positive). modifier-aggregation lead: ModifierEngine delegates summation to ModifierUtils.sumModifiers (delegation). damage-reduction lead getActorShieldRating reads derived.shield then stored system.shields with a documented legacy fallback (read-only, not a second authority).

findings.title: ModifierEngine (2,085 lines) holds source collectors for every domain
findings.observed: Collection of item, effect-intent, weapon, encumbrance, armor-usage, droid, vehicle and passive modifiers is hard-coded in one class, which is why it imports combat/equipment/droid/vehicle modules.
findings.intendedOwnership: ModifierEngine owns aggregation; domains register sources.
findings.proposedSolution: Introduce a source-registration seam (ModifierSourceRegistry) and move each collector next to its domain; ModifierEngine iterates registered sources. Keep output order and stacking identical.
findings.risk: Medium: ordering of sources affects breakdown display.

findings.intendedOwnership: This contract links the schema authority doc; guides corrected.
